answer: To enroll, reserve one night on a locked rooftop transit pier, seat a uniquely drilled saltwater pearl as the knife-edge bearing of a pocket scope, and expose a glass plate to a named nebula while a stylus on an oil pan records the roof's cooling ripple. Graders match the pearl's drill serial to the plate and the pan trace to the rooftop thermometer tape. A reused pier slot, recycled pearl, or copied plate is slashed as one operator. Fielding N identities costs N pier nights, N drilled pearls, and N live cooling traces that one roof cannot supply.
